ruled_by: coordinator, under the lead's delegation of 2026-10-14 (comment c-s5-labels-delegated)
label_meaning: 1 = the two names denote one quantity; 0 = distinct quantities
rule: A pair is a synonym when its divergent token makes no physical distinction under the token's own meaning, or when both names bind the same DD quantity. It is distinct when the token restricts the quantity: a sum over species or targets, a channel, a state against a species, a vector against its magnitude, a family head against one of its instances, or a different object. A description that fails to state a real restriction is recorded as a catalog defect, not read as a synonym.
evidence_read: each name's DD bindings and documentation, and its HAS_PARENT edges in both directions, read from the live graph on 2026-10-14
